conditionGrade.description: DS = unused/deadstock. A = very good used. B = normal used with visible wear. C = heavily used. UNKNOWN = the photos do not show enough to judge.

conditionDescription.description: In Korean, why this grade was given, referring only to what is visible in the photos.

defects.description: Every defect actually visible. Empty when none is visible.

description.description: In Korean, one sentence describing the defect as seen.

confidence.description: 0.0 to 1.0. How well the photos support this grade.

needsUserConfirmation.description: True when the photos do not cover the parts needed to grade confidently.

evidence.description: One entry for conditionGrade, plus one for each defect. A grade other than UNKNOWN must have evidence.

imageIndex.description: 0-based index of the image this was seen in.

observedText.description: Almost always null here. Only set when a condition claim rests on readable text, such as an unremoved retail tag.

observation.description: In Korean, one sentence stating what is visible at that spot.

sourceChunkId.description: Always null. Reserved for citing reference data supplied in the prompt.

unreadable.description: Parts that could not be checked because no photo covers them, with the reason. In Korean.
